title: Which Twilight character are you? Free Twilight quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Twilight quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Bella, Edward, Jacob, Alice, Carlisle, Rosalie, Jasper or Emmett. Unofficial Twilight Saga fan quiz, no spoilers, no sign-up.
lede: A quiet bookworm like Bella, sunny and loyal like Jacob or always a step ahead like Alice? Answer 12 questions to find your Twilight match.
about: Stephenie Meyer's Twilight novels, published from 2005 to 2008 and filmed from 2008 to 2012, follow Bella Swan after she moves to the rainy town of Forks, Washington, and meets the mysterious Cullen family. Their personalities are what fans argue about: thoughtful, stubborn Bella; brooding, protective Edward; warm, easygoing Jacob Black; bubbly Alice; Carlisle, the calm and caring doctor; fierce, honest Rosalie; quiet Jasper, who reads a room better than anyone; and big, playful Emmett. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. The questions are about personality, not plot, so there are no spoilers. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Stephenie Meyer, her publishers or the film studios; the names belong to their owners.

bella.name: Bella Swan
bella.body: You're thoughtful, independent and quietly brave. You'd rather curl up with a book than be the center of attention, but when someone you love needs you, you don't hesitate. You know your own mind, sometimes stubbornly, and you see people for who they really are.

edward.name: Edward Cullen
edward.body: You're intense, romantic and deeply protective. You think a lot, maybe too much, and you hold yourself to high standards. You have an old-fashioned side, a love of music and a loyalty that runs deep. Let yourself enjoy the moment instead of worrying about every way it could go wrong.

jacob.name: Jacob Black
jacob.body: You're warm, loyal and easy to be around. You light up a room, you love your friends and where you come from, and you'd rather fix something with your hands than talk about it for hours. You wear your heart on your sleeve, and people trust you for it.

alice.name: Alice Cullen
alice.body: You're bubbly, upbeat and always a step ahead. You plan the parties, pick the outfits and somehow know how things will turn out. Your optimism keeps your family going, and your loyalty is fierce. Just remember not everyone loves a surprise makeover.

carlisle.name: Carlisle Cullen
carlisle.body: You're calm, kind and wise beyond your years. You care for people whoever they are, you keep your head in a crisis and others come to you for advice. You lead by example, never by force. Make sure someone looks after you, too.

rosalie.name: Rosalie Hale
rosalie.body: You're fierce, honest and fiercely protective of the people you love. You can seem cold at first, but underneath is someone with strong feelings and clear values. You know what you want from life, you're handy with an engine and you never pretend to be something you're not.

jasper.name: Jasper Hale
jasper.body: You're quiet, perceptive and steadier than you look. You read the mood of a room in seconds and know how to calm people down. You keep some distance and think before you act, but your loyalty is real. Let people in a little; they'll be glad you did.

emmett.name: Emmett Cullen
emmett.body: You're big-hearted, playful and the life of the family. You love a challenge, a joke and a bit of friendly competition, and you rarely hold a grudge. People feel relaxed around you. Behind the fun is a protective friend who'd do anything for the people you love.
